description: Dostop do varnih kolesarskih in sprehajalnih poti, Slovenija, leto 2023 is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by NACIONALNI INŠTITUT ZA JAVNO ZDRAVJE. This collection automatically captures metadata sourced from the NATIONAL PUBLIC HEALTH INSTITUTE and corresponds to the original collection titled "Access to safe cycling and walking paths, Slovenia, 2023". The actual data is available in PC-Axis (.px) format. Coverage: NACIONALNI INŠTITUT ZA JAVNO ZDRAVJE. The portal shows the English title as "Access to safe cycling and walking paths, Slovenia, 2023" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is NACIONALNI INŠTITUT ZA JAVNO ZDRAVJE. Its keywords include NIJZ, zdravje. The listing shows 4 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
